<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  :root {
    --gold: #C9A84C; --gold-light: #E8C97A;
    --gold-dim: rgba(201,168,76,0.15); --gold-glow: rgba(201,168,76,0.25);
    --muted: #94A89A; --muted-light: #B8CCB8; --white: #EEF5EE;
    --border: rgba(201,168,76,0.2); --border-dim: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body { font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; color: var(--white); overflow-x: hidden; background: #071209; }
  #forest-bg { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; }
  #forest-canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
  #forest-bg::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(5,14,7,0.52) 0%, rgba(5,14,7,0.42) 40%, rgba(3,10,5,0.62) 100%);
    z-index: 1;
  }
  nav, .page-content, footer { position: relative; z-index: 10; }
  nav {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 52px; height: 66px;
    background: rgba(5,14,7,0.82); backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .nav-logo { font-family: "Syne", sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -0.5px; color: var(--white); text-decoration: none; }
  .nav-logo span { color: var(--gold); }
  .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 36px; align-items: center; }
  .nav-links a { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--gold); }
  .nav-cta { background: var(--gold) !important; color: #0A0A0A !important; padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px !important; font-weight: 700 !important; }
  .hero {
    min-height: 100vh; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    align-items: center; padding: 110px 52px 60px;
    max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; gap: 80px;
  }
  .hero-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 2.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 26px; }
  .hero-eyebrow::before { content: ""; width: 28px; height: 1.5px; background: var(--gold); display: block; }
  .hero-name { font-family: "Syne", sans-serif; font-size: clamp(42px, 5.5vw, 66px); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -2.5px; margin-bottom: 22px; color: var(--white); text-shadow: 0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); }
  .hero-name em { font-style: normal; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold) 0%, var(--gold-light) 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; }
  .hero-sub { font-size: 16.5px; color: var(--muted-light); line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 42px; max-width: 420px; font-weight: 300; text-shadow: 0 1px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); }
  .hero-actions { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 26px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.22s; }
  .btn-gold { background: var(--gold); color: #0A0A0A; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px var(--gold-glow); }
  .btn-gold:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 32px var(--gold-glow); }
  .btn-ghost { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: var(--muted-light); border: 1.5px solid var(--border-dim); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }
  .btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--gold); background: var(--gold-dim); }
  .hero-visual { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative; }
  .avatar-wrap { position: relative; }
  .avatar-ring { width: 340px; height: 340px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold) 0%, var(--gold-light) 50%, #6B4E10 100%); padding: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 60px var(--gold-glow), 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); animation: float 7s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes float { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(-14px)} }
  .avatar-inner { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #0D1F0F; }
  .avatar-inner img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center top; }
  .floating-badge { position: absolute; background: rgba(8,20,10,0.88); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--white); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }
  .badge-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #22C55E; animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes pulse { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0.3} }

  .d1{transition-delay:0.1s} .d2{transition-delay:0.2s} .d3{transition-delay:0.3s}
  @media (max-width: 768px) {

<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("forest-canvas");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
function rand(a,b){return Math.random()*(b-a)+a;}
function resize(){canvas.width=window.innerWidth;canvas.height=window.innerHeight;drawForest();}
function drawForest(){
  const W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  const sky=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H*0.6);
  sky.addColorStop(0,"#010D03");sky.addColorStop(0.4,"#021A08");sky.addColorStop(1,"#031F0A");
  ctx.fillStyle=sky;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  drawHills(W,H,[
    {y:H*0.38,amp:H*0.09,freq:0.0018,color:"rgba(10,40,15,0.55)",seed:1},
    {y:H*0.44,amp:H*0.07,freq:0.0024,color:"rgba(12,50,18,0.65)",seed:2},
    {y:H*0.50,amp:H*0.08,freq:0.003,color:"rgba(8,38,14,0.75)",seed:3},
  ]);
  drawRiver(W,H);
  drawHills(W,H,[
    {y:H*0.60,amp:H*0.06,freq:0.004,color:"rgba(6,30,10,0.88)",seed:4},
    {y:H*0.68,amp:H*0.05,freq:0.005,color:"rgba(4,22,8,0.92)",seed:5},
  ]);
  const floor=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,H*0.72,0,H);
  floor.addColorStop(0,"#020E04");floor.addColorStop(1,"#010804");
  ctx.fillStyle=floor;ctx.fillRect(0,H*0.72,W,H*0.28);
  for(let i=0;i<28;i++){const x=(W/27)*i+rand(-30,30);drawTree(x,H*rand(0.42,0.58),rand(H*0.18,H*0.32),rand(18,38),"rgba(3,15,6,0.7)");}
  for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const x=(W/19)*i+rand(-20,20);drawTree(x,H*rand(0.62,0.72),rand(H*0.22,H*0.38),rand(22,48),"rgba(2,10,4,0.85)");}
  for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const x=(W/11)*i+rand(-30,30);drawTree(x,H*0.82,rand(H*0.32,H*0.52),rand(35,65),"rgba(1,8,3,0.95)");}
  drawCanopy(W,H);
  const mist=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.5,H*0.48,0,W*0.5,H*0.48,W*0.55);
  mist.addColorStop(0,"rgba(201,168,76,0.04)");mist.addColorStop(0.5,"rgba(201,168,76,0.015)");mist.addColorStop(1,"transparent");
  ctx.fillStyle=mist;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
}
function hillPath(W,H,yBase,amp,freq,seed){
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,H);
  for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=4){
    const y=yBase-amp*(0.5*Math.sin(x*freq+seed)+0.3*Math.sin(x*freq*2.1+seed*1.7)+0.2*Math.sin(x*freq*3.7+seed*2.3));
    x===0?ctx.moveTo(x,y):ctx.lineTo(x,y);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W,H);ctx.closePath();
}
function drawHills(W,H,hills){hills.forEach(h=>{hillPath(W,H,h.y,h.amp,h.freq,h.seed);ctx.fillStyle=h.color;ctx.fill();});}
function drawRiver(W,H){
  const yS=H*0.52,yE=H*0.74;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(W*0.1,yS);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(W*0.25,yS+(yE-yS)*0.2,W*0.35,yS+(yE-yS)*0.4,W*0.45,yS+(yE-yS)*0.55);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(W*0.55,yS+(yE-yS)*0.7,W*0.65,yS+(yE-yS)*0.85,W*0.85,yE);
  const rg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,yS,0,yE);
  rg.addColorStop(0,"rgba(30,80,50,0.35)");rg.addColorStop(0.5,"rgba(20,60,40,0.45)");rg.addColorStop(1,"rgba(10,40,25,0.3)");
  ctx.strokeStyle=rg;ctx.lineWidth=24;ctx.lineCap="round";ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(W*0.12,yS+4);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(W*0.26,yS+(yE-yS)*0.22,W*0.36,yS+(yE-yS)*0.42,W*0.46,yS+(yE-yS)*0.57);
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(201,168,76,0.07)";ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.stroke();
}
function drawTree(x,baseY,height,width,color){
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(x-width*0.08,baseY-height*0.15,width*0.16,height*0.18);ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fill();
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const lH=height*(0.4+i*0.05),lW=width*(1-i*0.15),lY=baseY-height*(0.1+i*0.2);
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,lY-lH);ctx.lineTo(x-lW/2,lY);ctx.lineTo(x+lW/2,lY);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fill();
  }
}
function drawCanopy(W,H){
  for(let i=0;i<22;i++){
    const x=rand(0,W),dl=rand(H*0.06,H*0.18),lw=rand(30,80);
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+rand(-20,20),dl*0.5,x+rand(-10,10),dl);
    ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(5,30,10,0.7)";ctx.lineWidth=rand(1,3);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,dl,lw/2,lw/3,rand(-0.5,0.5),0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba("+Math.floor(rand(3,10))+","+Math.floor(rand(25,45))+","+Math.floor(rand(8,18))+","+rand(0.5,0.85)+")";ctx.fill();
  }
  const tg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H*0.22);
  tg.addColorStop(0,"rgba(2,14,5,0.97)");tg.addColorStop(0.7,"rgba(3,18,7,0.6)");tg.addColorStop(1,"transparent");
  ctx.fillStyle=tg;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H*0.22);
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,0);
  for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=8){
    const y=H*0.08+H*0.06*(0.5*Math.sin(x*0.008)+0.3*Math.sin(x*0.02+1)+0.2*Math.sin(x*0.035+2));
    ctx.lineTo(x,y);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W,0);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle="rgba(1,10,3,0.99)";ctx.fill();
}
const particles=[];
for(let i=0;i<60;i++){
  particles.push({
    x:Math.random()*window.innerWidth,y:Math.random()*window.innerHeight*0.75+window.innerHeight*0.15,
    r:Math.random()*1.8+0.4,gold:Math.random()>0.65,speed:Math.random()*0.4+0.1,
    angle:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,turn:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.03,
    blink:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,blinkSpeed:Math.random()*0.04+0.01
  });
}
function animate(){
  drawForest();
  const W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height;
  particles.forEach(p=>{
    p.angle+=p.turn;p.x+=Math.cos(p.angle)*p.speed;p.y+=Math.sin(p.angle)*p.speed*0.4;p.blink+=p.blinkSpeed;
    if(p.x<0)p.x=W;if(p.x>W)p.x=0;if(p.y<H*0.1)p.y=H*0.85;if(p.y>H*0.88)p.y=H*0.15;
    const alpha=(Math.sin(p.blink)*0.5+0.5)*(p.gold?0.7:0.4);
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.gold?"rgba(201,168,76,"+alpha+")":"rgba(160,230,170,"+alpha+")";ctx.fill();
    if(alpha>0.3){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r*3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=p.gold?"rgba(201,168,76,"+(alpha*0.15)+")":"rgba(160,230,170,"+(alpha*0.12)+")";ctx.fill();}
  });
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
window.addEventListener("resize",resize);
resize();animate();
const obs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{entries.forEach(el=>{if(el.isIntersecting){el.target.classList.add("visible");obs.unobserve(el.target);}});},{threshold:0.1});
document.querySelectorAll(".fade-up").forEach(el=>{obs.observe(el);if(el.getBoundingClientRect().top<window.innerHeight)el.classList.add("visible");});
document.querySelectorAll("a[href^=\"#\"]").forEach(a=>{a.addEventListener("click",e=>{e.preventDefault();const t=document.querySelector(a.getAttribute("href"));if(t)t.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"});});});
</script>
</body>
</html>
